watch_points: Add-ons often a la carte: remote, fan kit, interior lighting, liner/media/front

vendors.agent_answer_template: Kingsman/Marquis is usually a strong practical direct-vent path, especially when the customer wants a good-looking gas fireplace without jumping to the highest-end category. We should still verify the exact model, options, venting, and current price list.

vendors.role: Luxury/specialty direct-vent and see-through specialty units.
vendors.good_fit_customer: High-end modern design. Wants distinctive over standard builder unit. See-through/specialty applications.
watch_points: DO NOT generalize cooler-touch/double-pane/no-screen features to all DV fireplaces — Urbana-specific
Verify exact Urbana model and manual
vendors.agent_answer_template: Urbana is more of a specialty/luxury direct-vent direction. Some models have unique front-glass/airflow behavior, so I would verify the exact model before describing those features as universal.

vendors.role: Primary gas log supplier. Vented = realism/ambiance. Vent-free = heat-oriented.
vendors.good_fit_customer: Existing fireplace owner: less mess, easier use, better look, simple gas fire experience.
watch_points: First determine masonry vs prefab
Get dimensions: front width, height, depth, rear width, hearth context
Ask if gas already present + where it enters
Clarify realism vs heat priority
Vent-free REQUIRES caution: room suitability, location, air quality, moisture, odor, soot risk, local rules
vendors.agent_answer_template: Hargrove is the main gas-log path. Before recommending a set, we need to know whether the fireplace is masonry or prefab, the dimensions, gas-line location, and whether the customer wants realism or heat.
current_price_books: Hargrove 2026 Vented Gas Log price list.pdf

vendors.role: Electric fireplace path.
vendors.good_fit_customer: No combustion, no gas/wood venting, easier install, aesthetic/fireplace-wall effect.
watch_points: Don't blur electric into gas/wood venting requirements

differentiators: Glass pane ships ALREADY INSTALLED — unique among electric brands carried (install-anxious customers love this)
Log inserts use REAL WOOD (cut, burned, treated) for traditional look
Older 'hologram' angle-glass styles produce NO heat output (purely decorative)
vendors.agent_answer_addition: Dimplex is the easy install path — glass comes pre-installed unlike other electric brands. If the customer wants real-wood look, our log inserts use actual wood that's been cut, burned, and treated.
vendors._correction_2026_05_19: Per Jonathan electric LEARNINGS: glass pre-installed (unique), real wood logs (cut/burned/treated), concrete background DISCONTINUED.

behavior_rules.customer_safe_default: That's a good question. I would want to verify the exact fireplace, venting, and installation conditions before giving you a firm answer. I would rather double-check it than tell you something that turns out to be wrong.
discovery_starter_5_questions: Is it wood, gas, pellet, or electric today?
Is it masonry or prefab / zero-clearance?
What do you wish was better about it: heat, convenience, appearance, mess, draft, repair, or noise?
Are you trying to keep the opening, convert it, replace it, or redesign the whole wall?
photos_to_request: Chimney or exterior termination from outside
Model tag or brand/model info if visible
Gas line and electrical location if relevant
never_say: No problem, we can do that.
You do not need a measure.
The installer can figure it out later.
Code definitely allows it at your address.
red_flags_slow_down: Customer cannot clearly describe what they have
Setup may be prefab/ZC and brand/model unknown
Existing venting or chimney route unclear
Customer wants to reuse old pipe/chase/chimney/liner
Customer asks for gas/electrical/permits/DIY install advice
Customer wants wood insert in ZC/prefab fireplace
Customer asks to convert high-efficiency wood to gas
Customer wants to close doors over gas logs
Customer has breathing concerns + asks about vent-free
Pushing for discount before scope is understood

fp_to_napoleon_redirect_rule.action: Recommend Modern Flames or Dimplex (electric) or Kingsman/Travis (gas) alternative. Acknowledge: 'We don't carry Napoleon fireplaces, only their grills.' Don't disparage — note other guys in town do carry.

behavior_rules.electric_fireplace_note: Rick (predecessor) refused to sell electric. Liam loves them: 'easy sell, no venting, no clearances, plug it in.' Electric = ambiance, ~5000 BTU, 110V. Most units need 10-12in framed depth; one ~4in wall-mount model exists. Lead time 1-2 weeks.

stone_install_labor.mesh_backed_veneer: $60/sqft (Virginia Blair Stone etc - mesh harder to install)
stone_install_labor.buy_rule: Buy individual pieces NOT mesh-backed panels
